senses.gloss:
mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Like, resembling, similar.
m. (-भः)
1 Fraud, trick, disguise.
2 Light, manifestation.
E.
नि before भा to shine, affix ड.

n. (-नं)
Sight, seeing.
E.
नि before भाल to see, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Past, gone.
E.
नि affirmative, भूत been.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Modest, humble, unassuming.
2 Lonely, solitary.
E.
नि before भृ to cherish, affix क्त.

ind.
1 Privately, apart.
2 Unobservedly in a corner.
3 Covertly, in disguise or out of sight.
E.
नि before भृ to cherish, affix क्त, and मुट् added.
